name: image-template-survivors-like-horde-gameplay-mock
title: Survivors-Like Horde Gameplay Mock

title_i18n.zh-CN: 割草类（幸存者like）尸潮玩法样机

description: A mid-run gameplay mock for a survivors-like / bullet-heaven game: a lone hero in a clear ring surrounded by hundreds of enemies, orbiting auto-attack weapons, XP gems and the genre HUD (run timer, XP bar, weapon slots). Tuned for readability of the player inside visual chaos.

description_i18n.en: A mid-run gameplay mock for a survivors-like / bullet-heaven game: a lone hero in a clear ring surrounded by hundreds of enemies, orbiting auto-attack weapons, XP gems and the genre HUD (run timer, XP bar, weapon slots). Tuned for readability of the player inside visual chaos.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 为割草类 / 弹幕天堂（bullet heaven）游戏生成局中玩法样机：孤身主角站在清晰的空圈中，被数百敌人包围，环绕的自动攻击武器、经验宝石以及该类型标准 HUD（计时器、经验条、武器栏）。重点保证混乱画面中玩家依然清晰可辨。

query.en:
An in-game screenshot mock of a survivors-like (bullet heaven) action roguelite, captured {argument name="run_minute" default="14 minutes"} into a run when the screen is at its most chaotic and satisfying.

Setting: {argument name="setting" default="a moonlit graveyard field with broken fences and scattered tombstones"}.
Art style: {argument name="art_style" default="chunky 2D pixel art, 16x16 enemy sprites with dark outlines, top-down three-quarter view"}.
Player: {argument name="player" default="a small hooded alchemist with a glowing satchel"}, standing at the exact centre of the screen.

# Gameplay layer
- Hundreds of enemies ({argument name="enemy_horde" default="shambling skeletons, bats and a few larger armoured ghouls"}) pressing in from every side, packed into a dense ring that leaves a clear circle of empty ground around the player.
- Auto-attack weapons visibly working: {argument name="weapons" default="three orbiting potion flasks, a chain-lightning arc jumping between enemies, and a slow pulsing aura"}.
- Enemies being destroyed with small pops and white hit-flash frames; a trail of blue and green XP gems scattered on the ground; one treasure chest pickup near the edge of the clear ring.
- A few small white damage numbers floating up, never covering the player.

# HUD (genre-standard layout)
- Full-width XP bar along the very top with a level number at its right end.
- Run timer large and centred just below the XP bar.
- Weapon and passive item slots as two rows of small square icons in the top-left.
- Kill counter and gold counter in the top-right. A small health bar directly under the player sprite.

# Readability rules
- The player is the most saturated, brightest-outlined object on screen and is never overlapped.
- Enemies share a desaturated, darker value range so the horde reads as one mass; pickups and player effects use saturated, luminous colours.
- Palette: {argument name="palette" default="cool desaturated blues and greys for the field and horde, warm gold and cyan for player effects and pickups"}.
- Crisp, consistent pixel size; no blur.

# Avoid
Muddy overlapping effects that hide the player, mixed pixel resolutions, realistic rendering, gore, menu overlays, watermarks, real game logos or names.
